fact: Senegal's telecoms and digital ministry (DTIC) held a two-day workshop on 21-22 September 2026, with Smart Africa and GIZ, to validate a national Blueprint on Data Valorisation, whose roadmap, implementation framework and monitoring mechanism were to be refined before finalisation.

The article says Senegal has adopted its National Data Strategy (SND) and AI Strategy (SNIA), without giving the adoption date; the date used is the article's published date, which the file marks as an ingest-date proxy.

The ministry convened public, private and university actors with Smart Africa and GIZ on 1-2 July 2026 to identify use cases that will feed a national Blueprint for Value Creation Through Data, which Senegal is developing.
